1A: BIOS time or PCI service; check selector

21:4B: load or execute program or overlay; check AL

61: system control / PC speaker gate; inspect bits
3DA: color adapter status / control; inspect direction and bits

targets.video: Reproduce one original frame and palette. Compare pixels before adding window scaling or aspect options.
targets.input: Preserve held, pressed and released transitions. Replay a short input sequence before adding rebinding or controller support.
targets.timing: Measure original simulation ticks per action. Run at that cadence, then vary only the display refresh.
targets.clock: Identify calendar reads, timing reads and random seeding separately. Replay with a controlled clock.
targets.audio: Identify the actual device and event cadence. Compare one sound or music phrase before adding volume controls.
targets.files: Map DOS names, modes, seek offsets and short reads. Verify one asset load and one save/load round trip.
targets.storage: Map sector reads to verified media content and compare returned bytes.
targets.process: Distinguish exit, overlay loading and child programs. Reproduce the observed lifecycle.
targets.memory: Trace ownership and segment aliases before replacing allocation with native memory.
targets.console: Check whether this is gameplay text, setup output or an error message.
targets.system: Inspect the selected BIOS service or interrupt handler and its state changes.
targets.dos: Recover the DOS function selector and caller contract before choosing a native API.
targets.hardware: Resolve the port, transfer direction and bit usage before naming the device.
targets.interrupt: Identify the game's installed handler before assigning a subsystem.
targets.dpmi: Identify the actual protected-mode image and its entry point before porting gameplay.
